title: GIF Recorder Service State
description: Captures a sequence of image frames from the pipeline and encodes them into an animated GIF. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/gif-encoder)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

recording.description: true to start recording; false to stop and emit the GIF

delayMs.description: Inter-frame delay in milliseconds (controls playback speed)

maxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames to buffer before stopping automatically
